# Telegram Mini Apps SDK fixture

`telegram-web-app.js` is the unmodified script served by Telegram for Mini Apps. Telegram's official documentation instructs developers to load it from `https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js` before application scripts: [Mini Apps documentation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps).

Pinned SHA-256: `3549138a7934039fe7dfd1291a4ee739bd2b705a614308053a8b08a87d85c451`.

This fixture is for protocol compatibility tests. It does not certify behavior for any Telegram client profile or mark any registry row supported. Refresh it only with a reviewed source update and matching inventory hash.
